summary: Left mid-to-lower lung zone shows new patchy opacity with reduced aeration on the current image compared to the prior.

findings.rationale: Matched by diaphragmatic and hilar position, the prior left mid-lower lung is relatively clear with visible vessels; the current image at the same level shows patchy, denser opacity with blurred vascular margins, though added catheters and a one-day interval limit certainty this is not partly technical.
